home.fdeTitle: What is a Forward Deployed Engineer?
home.fdeDefinition: A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a senior software engineer who embeds directly with a client's team to turn a specific business problem into working software in production. Unlike a traditional contractor who waits for a finished spec, an FDE works alongside stakeholders, scopes the problem, builds full stack and ships — owning the outcome, not just the ticket.

fdeSteps.title: Embed
fdeSteps.body: I join your Slack, standups and calls to understand the business problem, the users and the constraints.

fdeSteps.title: Prototype
fdeSteps.body: A working prototype on real data within days, so decisions are made on software — not assumptions.

fdeSteps.title: Deploy
fdeSteps.body: Hardened, documented code shipped to production, with handoff to your team or ongoing support.

faqItems.question: What does a Forward Deployed Engineer do?
faqItems.answer: A Forward Deployed Engineer works directly with a client to understand a business problem and deliver a production-ready software solution — combining full stack development, integrations and AI deployment with close stakeholder communication.

faqItems.question: How is a Forward Deployed Engineer different from a freelance full stack developer?
faqItems.answer: A freelance developer typically executes a predefined task list. A Forward Deployed Engineer owns the business outcome: scoping the problem, choosing the right technical approach and shipping to production, with full stack engineering as the core skill.

faqItems.question: How fast can you deploy an MVP or integration to production?
faqItems.answer: Most MVPs and integrations reach production in 2 to 8 weeks, depending on scope. A working prototype on real data is usually available within the first week.

faqItems.question: Do you work with clients in the US and Europe?
faqItems.answer: Yes. I'm based in Ecuador (UTC−5), which overlaps the full US workday and the afternoon in Europe. I work remotely, in English, through Upwork or direct contract.
